$Comment: The Hallowed: the season's capstone, earned the moment every achievement tagged hallowed in
the Seasons > Hallows_Eve subcategory is earned in the same year. MetaSelector picks them, so a
new hallowed achievement counts toward it with no edit here; it never picks itself or another
capstone. It inherits the yearly occurrence, so each year has its own copy, and it pays the
title Hallows_Eve_Hallowed through the Title reward kind. Keep the hallowed tag off this file.
